sec-head.h2: What does a vector database engineer do?

p: A vector database engineer designs and deploys vector search systems: pipelines that store, index, and retrieve high-dimensional embeddings for similarity search. This includes vector database selection (Pinecone, Weaviate, Qdrant), embedding model tuning, hybrid search architecture, metadata filtering, and production scaling. A freelance vector database engineer delivers a deployed, integrated system, not just a proof-of-concept.

sec-head.h2: Vector DB engineer vs search engineer vs AI engineer

td: Vector database selection, indexing, embedding pipelines, hybrid search
You need a production-ready vector search system grounded in your data
Full-text search, relevance tuning, search ranking, and query understanding
You need advanced text search with traditional BM25 or Elasticsearch
Broader AI/ML system design, may include RAG, training, and MLOps
You need end-to-end AI infrastructure, vector search being one component
